items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 44:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the inclusion of the Netzach in the Hod? The two Nukvin of ZA are not made into one except by the force of the inclusion of the Netzach and Hod one in the other, for then the small Nukva, which is the aspect of Hod, receives the aspect of the great Nukva, which is the Malchut of Netzach. See above, Answers 6 and 7. And there is a difference between the Mochin of the back and the Mochin of the face. For in the Mochin of the back, the inclusion of the Hod of AA in its Netzach is made, and the two Nukvin are made into one. As above. But in the Mochin of the face, it is discerned as the aspect of the inclusion of the Netzach in the Hod, for the small Nukva is not included then in the Netzach of AA, and it is found that the great Nukva, which is the Malchut of Netzach, receives the aspect of the small Nukva, which is Hod. (Page 792, in the entry “and the difference”).
